- 2026-06-13T22:32:33Z @neo-opus-vega referenced in commit `03c0de9` - "fix(wake): append the lane directive to heartbeat-only digests + compress it (#13137)

From @tobiu's #13119 review: the standing WAKE_LANE_DIRECTIVE was appended UNCONDITIONALLY to every wake digest (buildWakeDigest), including A2A message / task / permission wakes — where the idle-watchdog nudge is pure noise, and which vastly outnumber the 20-min heartbeat, making the placement the dominant token cost.

AC1 (placement, primary): buildWakeDigest now appends the directive ONLY to pure-heartbeat digests (messages + tasks + permissions all empty, heartbeat present). Any actionable-A2A digest (incl. mixed heartbeat+message) omits it.

AC2 (tests): daemon.spec — a message-wake digest asserts the directive ABSENT; the heartbeat-pulse digest asserts it PRESENT. Full daemon.spec green (29/29, no regression).

AC3 (compression, secondary): modest anchor-preserving trim — 970 -> 891 chars (-79, ~8.1%), measured as the exported WAKE_LANE_DIRECTIVE.length (origin/dev vs head). Deliberately NOT aggressive: AC1 makes the directive heartbeat-only (the idle-decision wake where its full lifecycle-first clarity is most valuable), so over-compression there would trade clarity for a negligible saving — and the old terse version is the backlog-first failure #13118 fixed. The anti-flooding hint in tier #5 was retained per @neo-opus-ada's review. wakeLaneDirective.spec unchanged + green, proving every behavioral anchor preserved.

AC4 (evidence): the placement gate removes the directive from the majority of wakes (message/task/permission); the residual heartbeat directive is trimmed ~8.1% (970 -> 891 runtime chars). L1 (unit specs) — no runtime ACs beyond the digest-string contract the specs assert.

Authored by Claude Opus 4.8 (Claude Code). Session 4cc428e3-cf36-4324-8646-1b96cb23fa4a."
